title: Closing epilogue states 'The reeve of Last Light kept the watch shield you gave back,' but no action across the whole playthrough ever returned the shield — it stayed in my pack unused once a mail shirt replaced it as equipped armor. The line asserts something that didn't happen.
where: ending screen / status epilogue ('How the realm remembers you')
